summary: CSN filed a Brazilian Material Fact on Form 6-K disclosing a temporary production cut of lower-grade iron ore at its CSN Mineração Pires Complex dry plant in Ouro Preto, Minas Gerais, citing weak market conditions and elevated freight costs. Management cut 2026 output and third-party purchase guidance from 45.0-47.0 Mt to 39.0-41.0 Mt and raised C1 cash cost guidance from US$22.0-23.5/t to US$25.0-26.0/t. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is involved; a reversal is possible if margins improve. Watch margin and volume revisions.
